data.situation:
On Wednesday, 15 September, at three, Lin placed her review beside the library return slip. Maya had borrowed another short story, “The Quiet Station”, to compare with their choice. Its setting was similar to Rowe’s, but its visitor arrived before the main character had time to prepare. Lin had mentioned every event in her first draft. Reading it aloud, she found that the list spoiled the flow. She crossed out two details and wrote what had stayed with her: an empty chair, a lamp and the girl’s hesitation. Maya looked at the structure of one long sentence and suggested separating its two ideas. They kept both versions on the revision sheet. The tutor’s message sat beside them, with Friday’s submission date circled and a note about the studio beyond the library side door. From your tutor
The due date for the review is Friday, 17 September. Explain one similarity between the stories, then say what differs. Rowe’s story leaves the visitor’s purpose uncertain; the other story likewise leaves a question unanswered. You need not retell every event. Bring your revised page to the studio on Friday, after submitting the review. The workshop teacher will meet you by the drawing table.

readingBlocks.zh: 9月15日星期三，下午三点，林把短评放在图书馆还书单旁。玛雅另借了一篇《安静的车站》，想和她们选的作品比较。它的场景与罗的故事相似，不过来客在主人公来得及准备之前就到了。林的初稿提到了每一件事，读出声后才发现，这样列举破坏了行文的流畅。她删去两个细节，写下真正留在自己心里的东西：空椅子、灯，还有女孩的迟疑。玛雅看了看一个长句的结构，建议把其中两个意思分开。她们把两个版本都留在修订页上。导师的消息放在旁边，周五的提交日期被圈了起来，下面还提到了图书馆侧门外的工作室。

readingBlocks.en:
From your tutor
The due date for the review is Friday, 17 September. Explain one similarity between the stories, then say what differs. Rowe’s story leaves the visitor’s purpose uncertain; the other story likewise leaves a question unanswered. You need not retell every event. Bring your revised page to the studio on Friday, after submitting the review. The workshop teacher will meet you by the drawing table.
readingBlocks.zh:
导师发来的消息
短评的提交日期是9月17日星期五。先说明两篇故事的一个相似之处，再写差别。罗的故事没有交代清楚来客的目的，另一篇同样留了一个问题没有回答。不必复述每一件事。周五交完短评后，请把修订页带到工作室，工作坊老师会在画图桌旁等你们。

glossary.zh: 对作品发表意见的评论；书评
glossary.note: review此处名词，Lin写出的短评；温习或审阅的动词未教。
glossary.example: Lin placed her review beside the library return slip.
glossary.exampleZh: 林把短评放在图书馆还书单旁。

externalEvidence.definition: an essay or article that gives a critical evaluation (as of a book or play)

glossary.note: be similar to后接比较对象；本句只说场景相似，不能推出作品内容完全相同。
glossary.example: Its setting was similar to Rowe’s, but its visitor arrived before the main character had time to prepare.
glossary.exampleZh: 它的场景与罗的故事相似，不过来客在主人公来得及准备之前就到了。

externalEvidence.label: Collins English Dictionary
externalEvidence.reviewFinding: COBUILD adjective similar + to and British usage note

glossary.note: likewise连接具体相似点：两篇都留一个未回答的问题；不随意连接相反观点，与旧similarly的身份边界需整合审校。
glossary.example: Rowe’s story leaves the visitor’s purpose uncertain; the other story likewise leaves a question unanswered.
glossary.exampleZh: 罗的故事没有交代清楚来客的目的，另一篇同样留了一个问题没有回答。

externalEvidence.definition: in like or similar manner- Samuel Johnson

glossary.zh: 语言表达平顺连贯的流畅感
glossary.note: the flow在本句为短评行文连贯，不是物理水流或口语语速。
glossary.example: Reading it aloud, she found that the list spoiled the flow.
glossary.exampleZh: 读出声后，她发现这样列举破坏了行文的流畅。

externalEvidence.label: University of Waterloo Writing and Communication Centre
externalEvidence.publisher: University of Waterloo Writing and Communication Centre
externalEvidence.reviewFinding: Writing coherence: logical connection of ideas and natural cadence

glossary.note: 短评必须提交的日期9月17日，非借书归还日期或预产期。
glossary.example: The due date for the review is Friday, 17 September.
glossary.exampleZh: 短评的提交日期是9月17日星期五。

glossary.zh: 句子各部分的组织与关系；句子结构
glossary.note: 本句structure指句子各部分的组织，复用旧宽义；保留旧全局实物例句和原词典sense，新的句中对象另解释。
glossary.example: Maya looked at the structure of one long sentence and suggested separating its two ideas.
glossary.exampleZh: 玛雅看了看一个长句的结构，建议把其中两个意思分开。

retrievalPrompts.function: The review beside the return slip
retrievalPrompts.cue: Your draft lists every event. Explain what you would change in the review.
retrievalPrompts.cueZh: 写短评时，你发现自己把所有情节列了一遍，怎样说明你想改进哪里？
acceptableAnswers: My review retells too much. I want to improve the flow by keeping only the details that matter.
checks: 表达与眼前情境相符；允许其他自然说法

retrievalPrompts.function: The review beside the return slip
retrievalPrompts.cue: Tell a classmate one clear similarity between the stories, without saying they are identical.
retrievalPrompts.cueZh: 同学问两篇故事哪里相像，怎样说一个明确相似点，又避免把它们说成完全一样？
acceptableAnswers: The setting is similar to Rowe’s, and both stories leave a question unanswered. The other story likewise keeps the visitor’s purpose unclear.
checks: 表达与眼前情境相符；允许其他自然说法

retrievalPrompts.function: The review beside the return slip
retrievalPrompts.cue: Your tutor asks what you will change in the sentence and when the work is due. Respond.
retrievalPrompts.cueZh: 导师问你下一步怎么改长句、什么时候交，你会怎样回答？
acceptableAnswers: I will change the structure of this sentence. The due date is Friday, 17 September.
checks: 表达与眼前情境相符；允许其他自然说法

transferPrompt.function: The review beside the return slip
transferPrompt.cue: You are writing a film review for a school paper. Explain how you would keep it coherent without listing the whole plot.
transferPrompt.cueZh: 换成给校报写一篇电影评论，你会怎样把意见写得连贯，而不是列完整情节？
acceptableAnswers: I would write a short review around one main point and use a few scenes to support it, so the flow is clear.
checks: 表达与眼前情境相符；允许其他自然说法
